read.thesis: Tenet resolves Conifer JV with CommonSpirit, receiving ~$1.9B over three years, and flags FY25 Adjusted EBITDA at upper end of $4.47–4.57B guidance; no supply signal, mainly a capital-structure event.

triggers.label: FY25 Adj EBITDA at upper end of range
triggers.quote: the Company currently estimates that its Adjusted EBITDA for the year ended December 31, 2025, will be at the upper end of its current Adjusted EBITDA guidance range of $4.47 billion to $4.57 billion

triggers.label: CommonSpirit exits Conifer JV
triggers.quote: Payments totaling approximately $1.9 billion from CommonSpirit to Tenet in installments over the next three years

guidance.quote: will be at the upper end of its current Adjusted EBITDA guidance range of $4.47 billion to $4.57 billion

red_flags.label: Preliminary results may change
red_flags.quote: The Company's actual results for the year ended December 31, 2025 may differ from preliminary estimates
